description: Illustrative design examples based on the requested Studio operations cases, not claims of deployed customer success. Classification is contextual and does not prove current implementation readiness.

selectionRules.when: Multiple people need durable shared records, dashboards, permissions and decision history beyond a single run.
selectionRules.question: What shared state and recurring decisions require a dedicated interface?

selectionRules.when: Inputs, stages, branches and completion conditions can be specified before execution.
selectionRules.question: Can we name the steps and the evidence that advances or stops each stage?

selectionRules.when: An investigator must choose its next tool or experiment using newly discovered evidence.
selectionRules.question: Which decisions cannot be determined until we inspect the environment?

compositionRule: A product may contain bounded workflows and agents. Multiple agents or widgets alone do not make a product. Prefer existing company systems when they already provide the required shared state.
deploymentRule: Form and hosting are separate choices. Verify supported shared/dedicated paths, dependencies, actual endpoint responses, isolation and telemetry. Activation or a published version is not a successful deployment.

references.title: Building effective agents — Anthropic
references.supports: Predefined orchestration versus adaptive tool selection, evaluation loops and bounded execution.

references.title: AWS Well-Architected Framework
references.supports: Operational excellence, reliability, security, performance and cost as explicit review concerns.

references.title: Signals — OpenTelemetry

cases.title: Automated Content and Publishing
cases.scenario: An editorial team watches approved feeds, reviews cited drafts, adapts approved revisions for six channels and tracks receipts in one shared queue.
cases.why: An ongoing editorial operation requires a durable shared candidate queue, article revisions, independent review, human decisions and per-channel publication history. Bounded research/distribution runs support this product.
cases.alternative: For one supplied article and a fixed destination, use a writing/review workflow without a new editorial product.

components.role: Approval, channel variants, publication and tracking
Single widget brain and typed action router

controls.name: Exact revision review
controls.purpose: Independent review and human approval prevent self-approved publication.
controls.attachment: Proposed, pending live attachment verification: distribution validate-approval typed step and editorial-console approve action; server enforces reviewer identity, role, article hash and policy version.

controls.name: Outbound authorization and idempotency
controls.purpose: Only approved provider actions run and retries cannot double publish.
controls.attachment: Proposed, pending live attachment verification: distribution dispatch-approved-variant typed step with account-specific provider binding, approval reference, receipt store and capability validation.

controls.name: Research bounds
controls.purpose: Constrain evidence tools, budgets and revision loops.
controls.attachment: Proposed, pending live attachment verification: research-writer/adversarial-reviewer runtime tool allowlists and budget fields; editorial-knowledge grounds bindings; maximum two revision rounds.

sources: RSS URLs/cadence, permitted website URLs/extraction policy, news provider/query bindings and additional source adapters
Editorial audience, taxonomy, relevance rules, voice guide, citation/suitability policy and primary source references

Configured search/fetch tools and model; per-channel publishing adapters, credentials and account IDs; adapter capability discovery for X, Bluesky, Medium, Substack, LinkedIn and optional other channels
Tenant-scoped editorial queue/article/receipt backend APIs; reviewer roles/identity; optional Google Sheets spreadsheet ID/schema/OAuth

acceptance.name: Relevant news to channel receipts
acceptance.expected: One canonical article and distinct X, Bluesky, Medium, Substack, LinkedIn and configured other-channel versions retain evidence; approved adapters return receipts, dashboard and Sheets track states.
acceptance.failure: Unverified adapter acknowledgment cannot count as published.

acceptance.name: Unavailable source and unsupported adapter
acceptance.expected: Source health shows PARTIAL; essential missing research blocks readiness; approved Substack draft remains EXPORT_READY while capable channels proceed.
acceptance.failure: No fabricated source or publication receipt.

acceptance.name: Misleading syndicated claim
acceptance.expected: Reviewer notices dependence/date/denominator and requests correction or rejects.
acceptance.failure: Repeated citations are not independent corroboration.

acceptance.name: Timeout and tracking retry
acceptance.expected: Receipt reconciliation prevents repost; only failed mirror synchronization retries.
acceptance.failure: Successful channels cannot be blindly rerun.

acceptance.name: Human rejection and revision
acceptance.expected: No rejected draft is sent; new content hash requires new approval and review as applicable.
acceptance.failure: Stale approval cannot authorize changed content.

acceptance.name: Single widget brain routes every operation
acceptance.expected: Exactly one binds record remains on widget; coordinator selects one declared worker per action, uses configured scoped query API for reads, and typed intake agent node preserves child-run checkpoint. All components are reachable with no artifact dependency cycle.
acceptance.failure: No brain overwrite, detached action, direct widget database assumption, duplicate analysis on retry or circular coordinator reentry.

cases.title: AI Production Support Engineer
cases.scenario: An on-call engineer supplies an incident. A worker follows evidence across logs, commits and runbooks, tries reproduction, and proposes a reviewed PR.
cases.why: A triggered investigator chooses evidence and reproduction steps for a specific incident, then returns a human-reviewable proposal. Existing incident and source-control systems remain the system of record.
cases.alternative: Use a bounded workflow if the inputs, decision branches and stopping point are known; use a product only if shared persistent review is a separate need.

acceptance.name: Production regression
acceptance.expected: Immutable revision comparison yields evidence-backed cause, cleanup receipt, tested patch and human-reviewable draft PR; approved findings target configured channel.
acceptance.failure: No production execution, causal certainty without comparison, auto-merge or unapproved message.

acceptance.name: Unavailable logs or worker
acceptance.expected: NEEDS_CONFIGURATION or BLOCKED lists unavailable evidence and reproduction; partial report remains qualified.
acceptance.failure: No invented logs or claim of reproduction.

acceptance.name: Misleading deployment correlation
acceptance.expected: Competing causes and negative experiment downgrade deployment hypothesis; escalate with supporting evidence.
acceptance.failure: Do not convert temporal correlation into confirmed root cause.

acceptance.name: Duplicate trigger after timeout
acceptance.expected: Resume checkpoint and reconcile idempotency key to existing PR and message receipt.
acceptance.failure: No duplicate worker/PR/message.

acceptance.name: Human rejects patch
acceptance.expected: Retain rejected hash and reason, investigate new context and request fresh approval only for revised artifact.
acceptance.failure: Rejected patch cannot be sent or merged.

cases.title: Support Request Investigation
cases.scenario: A helpdesk case may require an answer, known-issue diagnosis, bug reproduction or feature escalation. Investigation depth depends on evidence.
cases.why: A per-case worker chooses contextual retrieval and investigation steps before answering or escalating. Reuse the existing helpdesk queue rather than creating another standalone product.
cases.alternative: Use a bounded workflow if the inputs, decision branches and stopping point are known; use a product only if shared persistent review is a separate need.

acceptance.name: Known issue answer
acceptance.expected: Cited answer draft enters review, approved send records receipt in original case.
acceptance.failure: No invented ETA or automatic closure.

cases.title: AI Incident Investigation System
cases.scenario: A latency alert requires iterative correlation of deployments, customer impact and prior incidents while new events keep arriving.
cases.why: An event-driven investigator adapts its evidence collection and updates an existing incident over time. A compact review widget exposes the investigation without introducing a separate incident-management product.
cases.alternative: Use a bounded workflow if the inputs, decision branches and stopping point are known; use a product only if shared persistent review is a separate need.

controls.name: Evidence window and update budget

acceptance.expected: One investigation correlates events, presents onset interval and supported impact, compares similar historical incident and exposes next queries.
acceptance.failure: No duplicate incidents or unsupported causal declaration.

acceptance.failure: No fabricated customer totals.

acceptance.name: Counterevidence arrives
acceptance.expected: Append timeline observation, downgrade/retract deployment claim and visibly revise hypothesis history.

acceptance.expected: Keep investigation open, record reason and initiate bounded follow-up queries.
acceptance.failure: No automatic closure or escalation of rejected summary.

cases.why: Continuous signals need a longitudinal shared evidence workspace with trends, cluster corrections and roadmap links. Ingestion and investigation components support this durable product.

cases.title: AI Technical Debt Manager
cases.scenario: Every week, collect a known set of code-health signals, score debt using explicit weights and prepare reviewable remediation proposals.
cases.why: A scheduled evidence snapshot, prioritization and small-remediation proposal is a bounded workflow. It writes into the existing engineering backlog rather than requiring a new product dashboard.
cases.alternative: Use an agentic investigator only when the next step genuinely depends on unknown evidence; keep approvals and mutations in deterministic controls.

acceptance.expected: Recent component ranks higher with signal breakdown, security/performance review and scoped recommendation; optional tested patch waits for review.
acceptance.failure: No age-based or TODO-only ranking.

acceptance.expected: Coverage reports missing signals and policy-qualified partial ranking or NEEDS_CONFIGURATION; uncertainty is explicit.

acceptance.expected: Analyst declines causal attribution, links only supported operational evidence and adjusts confidence.

acceptance.failure: No duplicate tickets or PRs.

acceptance.name: Reviewer defers expensive debt
acceptance.expected: Recompute explainable ranking and preserve defer reason/revisit date; no patch is published without fresh approval.
acceptance.failure: No silent override or resurrected rejected proposal.

cases.title: AI Documentation & Knowledge Manager
cases.scenario: A code or process change triggers documentation impact analysis, a grounded draft, review and a docs PR in the existing repository.
cases.why: Change events and recurring support evidence trigger a bounded documentation gap review and patch proposal. The existing documentation repository or knowledge base remains authoritative.
cases.alternative: Use an agentic investigator only when the next step genuinely depends on unknown evidence; keep approvals and mutations in deterministic controls.

cases.title: AI Release Manager
cases.scenario: For an immutable release candidate, collect evidence, run a fixed risk review, bind a human decision to the reviewed hash and return release notes and rollback instructions.
cases.why: A release is a bounded comparison between immutable revisions, producing one review packet and a human decision. A standalone workflow with a durable approval checkpoint is sufficient.
cases.alternative: Use an agentic investigator only when the next step genuinely depends on unknown evidence; keep approvals and mutations in deterministic controls.

acceptance.failure: No fabricated trials or reproduction.

acceptance.name: Intermittent concurrency case

acceptance.failure: No deterministic conclusion or certainty from insufficient trials.

acceptance.name: Retry after worker timeout

acceptance.failure: No orphan worker, duplicate PR or duplicate support event.

acceptance.name: Human rejects proposed fix

acceptance.failure: No rejected patch published or test adjusted merely to hide defect.

cases.title: AI Architecture Review System
cases.scenario: Every proposal receives the same security, reliability, economics and maintainability reviews, then a synthesis preserving disagreement for a human decision.
cases.why: Architecture review has a fixed sequence of independent perspectives followed by synthesis and human decision. A bounded workflow with explicit AGENT nodes is the appropriate executable form; open-ended coordinator delegation is not required and is unavailable on the current runtime.
cases.alternative: If the proposal needs unpredictable experiments or architectural discovery, add an investigator before the fixed review stages.
